name: Incineration Beetle

abilities.name: Mandible Bite
abilities.description: A basic melee attack that does minor physical damage.

abilities.name: Fire Spit
abilities.description: When hit, the beetle releases three balls of fire onto the ground around itself dealing moderate flame damage over time. These fire pools persist for a long time and thus players should ensure they have enough damage to kill the beetles before the entire arena is covered.

related_quests: Fires of Battle: Compete in a fiery arena to claim the Brimstone Crown.
Pledge: Blessed Crucible: Prove you are truly Undaunted by clearing Blessed Crucible.
summary: Incineration Beetles are a magically corrupted strain of shalk that have been gathered for use in the Blessed Crucible. The Beast Master brought them from the ashlands of Morrowind. You will face four of them at once as the first challenge the Beast Master has prepared for you.
